# Test fixtures – provenance & licensing

These images are used only by the subservice's Go tests. They are bundled so
the recognition pipeline is exercised against **real photographs** of faces.

| File              | Source                                                                 | License / status |
|-------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------|
| `faces_sample.jpg`| Sample image shipped with [github.com/esimov/pigo](https://github.com/esimov/pigo) (`testdata/sample.jpg`) | MIT © 2018 Endre Simo |
| `person_a.jpg`    | Generated by StyleGAN (thispersondoesnotexist.com), downscaled to 360 px | Synthetic – depicts no real person; free to use |
| `person_b.jpg`    | Generated by StyleGAN (thispersondoesnotexist.com), downscaled to 360 px | Synthetic – depicts no real person; free to use |
| `person_c.jpg`    | Generated by StyleGAN (thispersondoesnotexist.com), downscaled to 360 px | Synthetic – depicts no real person; free to use |

The three `person_*.jpg` images are machine-generated faces of people who do
not exist, so there are no privacy or model-release concerns. They were chosen
because they are photo-realistic enough for the pigo detector to find a face
(unlike hand-drawn synthetic faces) while remaining licence-free.

The embedded face-detection cascade `../facefinder` is likewise from pigo
(MIT © 2018 Endre Simo).
